vi: Phân biệt EFS vs FSx: EFS là NFS elastic multi-AZ tự co giãn dung lượng; FSx Lustre cho HPC parallel throughput cao; FSx OpenZFS cho enterprise snapshot/compression.
Viết Terraform khai báo EFS file system + mount target mỗi AZ + access point chroot với POSIX uid/gid, hiểu tại sao thiếu mount target ở một AZ thì instance ở đó không mount được.
Cấu hình performance_mode (generalPurpose vs maxIO) và throughput_mode (bursting vs provisioned vs elastic) cho EFS phù hợp workload latency + IOPS yêu cầu.
Mount EFS từ nhiều EC2 ở khác AZ dùng mount target riêng mỗi AZ, access point để multi-tenant isolation với root directory cố định và POSIX identity ép.
So sánh FSx Lustre vs OpenZFS: Lustre cho dữ liệu scratch HPC ngắn hạn; OpenZFS cho dữ liệu persistent Linux cần ZFS feature (snapshot, compression, record size tuning).
en: Distinguish EFS vs FSx: EFS is an elastic multi-AZ NFS with automatic capacity scaling; FSx Lustre is for HPC with parallel high throughput; FSx OpenZFS is for enterprise snapshot and compression.
Write Terraform declaring an EFS file system plus mount targets per AZ plus access points that chroot with fixed POSIX uid/gid; understand why an AZ without a mount target cannot mount.
Configure performance_mode (generalPurpose vs maxIO) and throughput_mode (bursting vs provisioned vs elastic) for EFS to match latency and IOPS requirements of your workload.
Mount EFS from multiple EC2 instances across different AZs using a mount target per AZ, access points for multi-tenant isolation with fixed root directory and enforced POSIX identity.
Compare FSx Lustre vs OpenZFS: Lustre for short-lived HPC scratch data; OpenZFS for persistent Linux data needing ZFS features (snapshots, compression, record-size tuning).
